script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sci-Fi
Theme: friendship

Begin screenplay.

Title: The Quantum Leap

FADE IN:

EXT. CITY STREET - NIGHT

A neon-lit CITY, pulsing with life. PEOPLE walk in all directions, heads down, engrossed in their screens.

INT. LABORATORY - NIGHT

DR. AMARA RAO (30s, passionate scientist) hunches over her workbench, tweaking the settings on a large, complex MACHINE. She mutters to herself, focused.

Amara: (excited) It's almost time...

Suddenly, the machine hums to life, enveloping the room in a soft GLOW.

INT. LABORATORY - A MOMENT LATER

Amara gasps as a figure appears next to her - a MAN in his 20s, disheveled and drenched. This is WILL, our HERO.

Will: (startled) What the...?

Amara: (amazed) You're a quantum leap, Will! I've been waiting for you!

INT. LABORATORY - LATER

Amara explains to Will that he's a quantum leaper, someone who can jump through time and space. She shows him how to use the machine to navigate their way through dimensions.

INT. CITY PARK - DAY

Will and Amara, now friends, sit on a park bench. They discuss the potential uses of Will's ability and the dangers they might face.

Amara: (concerned) We need to be careful, Will. There are forces in this world that could exploit your power for their own gain.

Will: (determined) I'll do whatever it takes to protect those around me.

INT. CORPORATE TOWER - DAY

Will and Amara enter a towering CORPORATE TOWER to confront the VILLAIN, a ruthless CEO named SILAS. They learn that Silas intends to use the quantum leap ability for nefarious purposes.

INT. CORPORATE TOWER - LATER

A tense showdown between Will and Silas ensues. Amara and other scientists join the fray, using their knowledge and ingenuity to outsmart Silas.

Amara: (angry) You'll never hurt innocent people again, Silas!

Will: (defeating Silas) You're under arrest!

INT. LABORATORY - NIGHT

Will and Amara celebrate their victory, with Amara assuring Will that they can use his ability for good.

Amara: (smiling) Together, we'll change the world, Will.

INT. CITY STREET - NIGHT

The neon-lit city looks peaceful as Will and Amara walk away, ready for their next quantum leap.

Will: (to Amara) Ready for the next adventure?

Amara: (laughs) Always.

FADE OUT.

End screenplay.
